rules.KV: attention on SM (owner adoption 10-15, H-ATTQ B): KV rows stream PHY -> PC -> SM on the existing SM HBM port like weights; QK and PV each stream the row set (KV_hbm already counts both). kv_home=stack_local: dense rows are sequence-sliced to the SM whose stack holds them (token t -> SM t%32), DS top-k rows are rank-assigned (rank r -> SM r%32) and the compressed KV is replicated in all four stacks so every SM reads its rows from its own stack (+3 row writes per layer per token, +3x KV capacity); kv_home=interleave: one copy, top-k rows read across quadrants over the VM ring
rules.SCORES: partial scores out of each SM (FP32, heads x rows), softmax on SU (read scores, write P), P back to the SM on the x-load port, PV partial outputs back to VM and reduced by SU: Qwen 8 q heads x 8192 x 4 B x 36, DS 16 x 640 x 4 B x 40
rules.DESC: KV prefetch descriptors (row ids from window + IDX top-k) read by each SM from its quadrant VM hub: 4 B per row

attention.freed: ATT tiles, gathers, Q/P fields, reduction, ATT control, attention RG/WG, LG ATT groups, PV return (H-ATTQ: 111.1 mm2 / ~161 W on v14)

rules.SM_hbm: SM.MATVEC B(HBM) bytes / 32 SMs; each SM reads its own stack (stack=SM//8, PCs 4*(SM%8)..+3)
rules.SM_x: SM.MATVEC A(VM) bytes per SM (every SM loads the full x); x replicated per quadrant VM, read over 8 banks
rules.SU_vm: SU.VOP + FUSED norm/HC_PRE/HC_POST VM operands, SPMD over 4 quarters, 8 banks via LG near tap
rules.KV_hbm: model-derived row volume (program carries a descriptor): DS 40 x 640 x 8480 b; Qwen 36 x 2 x 2 x 8K x 128 B
rules.COLL: COLL VM operands per quarter; off-die = O bytes split over 9 links by link count; ring = 4 hop-bytes per byte / 8 directed links
rules.ATT_intra: SYSTEM_GRAPH T640 activity (Q 131,072 B, P 2,621,440 B, K|V 2,949,120 B/phase, PV fill 678,400 B, out 32,768 B) x invocations; Qwen scaled by KV volume

unknowns: SM tile parent pins unassigned (top-down pin assignment open): link length = closest-point Manhattan gap between outlines
Engine/VM hub/COLL/IDX/QUANT/HC engine areas are estimates (no physical views); ATT reduction tree unplaced in D
KV home mapping is not source-bound (KV_multistack_service UNJOINED); attention-on-SM assumes the stated kv_home layout
SM attention modes (PV accumulate, BF16 x with FP8/FP4 W, GQA multi-x, KV descriptor port) are not in RTL yet (H-ATTQ changes 1-5)
x replication across quadrants assumed (SU replica words); cross-quadrant traffic carried on VM ring
SerDes shoreline/package contract open; PHY command-level successor and 544/512 gearbox open
clock trees, PG, halos beyond 20 um, HOST/CP loader and ckgen not modelled
